positions.name: On Holding
positions.catalyst: Announced a share buyback of up to $1 billion running through 2029 plus new long-term financial targets; +6.33% pre-market.
positions.risks: Buyback is announced capacity, not executed repurchases. Stock printed its 52-week low of $26.365 on Sept 17, five sessions ago, and sits 43% below the January high of $51.08 - the buyback is a response to a broken chart, not a demand signal.

positions.name: Shopify
positions.catalyst: Mark Zuckerberg announced Monday that Meta is integrating Shopify into Muse, its personal AI agent, for in-agent shopping and checkout. Muse has been the #1 free US iPhone app for three straight days (Sensor Tower). SHOP ran from a $128.80 open to $138.03 on 16.6M shares vs an 8.5M 30-day average; +3.00% pre-market.
positions.risks: Chasing a second gap after a 7% Monday. No revenue-share or economics were disclosed for the Meta tie-up, and SHOP trades at 87x earnings, 13.1x book. 52-week range $94.00-$182.19.

positions.name: Lennar
positions.catalyst: Berkshire Hathaway disclosed a roughly $1.2 billion stake in Lennar; +1.60% pre-market. 10-year Treasury yield eased 4.1bp to 4.96%, off its highest level since 2007.
positions.risks: Monday's close of $78.08 sits just $2.38 above the Sept 18 52-week low of $75.70, and the stock is 42% below its December high of $133.76. Berkshire is a patient holder - a stake disclosure does not fix mortgage rates, and CME FedWatch puts 57.6% odds on another Fed HIKE after October.

positions.name: Paramount Skydance
positions.catalyst: Settled the 12-state AG antitrust suit AND the Writers Guild suit on Sept 21 - the only two remaining barriers to closing the $110B Warner Bros. Discovery acquisition (EU and UK already cleared). Paramount said earlier this month all other closing conditions were satisfied. PSKY FELL 2.9% Monday while WBD rose 11%, so the acquirer has not repriced. +2.22% pre-market. EXIT TRIGGER: close on announcement of deal completion, or on any court refusing to approve the consent decree.
positions.risks: Settlement is subject to court approval and carries real cost: $300M+ per year of incremental US film production for five years, 30-32 movies annually, a three-year freeze on theater rate increases, a $47.5M worker fund and a news editorial-independence board over CBS and CNN. Tender/exchange offers for Discovery notes were extended to Oct 2 with only 66.87%/75.12% tendered as of Sept 18. Negative trailing earnings (PE -17.6).
positions.driver: Final antitrust barrier to the $110B WBD close removed

positions.name: Merck & Co.
positions.catalyst: FDA approved a US label update for WINREVAIR (sotatercept-csrk) at 7:15 AM ET today, based on the Phase 3 HYPERION trial in newly diagnosed pulmonary arterial hypertension - a 76% reduction in risk of clinical worsening vs placebo (HR 0.24), expanding the addressable population to recently diagnosed patients.
positions.risks: Label expansion rather than a new approval, so the revenue delta is incremental. Pre-market move is only +0.27% - the market is not treating this as a needle-mover. Stock is near the top of its 52-week range ($77.58-$156.92) and carries a 119x trailing PE.
positions.driver: FDA label expansion for WINREVAIR on HYPERION data

positions.name: GRAIL
positions.catalyst: FDA's Molecular and Clinical Genetics Panel meets Wednesday Sept 23 to discuss and vote on the premarket approval application for Galleri, GRAIL's multi-cancer early-detection blood test. EXIT TRIGGER: close on the panel vote outcome.
positions.risks: HALF SIZE ON PURPOSE - this is a binary advisory-panel vote with two-way gap risk. The market already front-ran it: GRAL ran from a $92.01 open to a $111.49 high Monday (+17%) on 3.5M shares vs a 1.0M 30-day average, so the good outcome is partly paid for. Pre-market book is $106.00/$110.00, a 3.7% spread on a 42M-share float. PE -11.1. 52-week range $41.50-$118.84.
positions.driver: Sept 23 FDA advisory panel vote on Galleri

positions.name: IonQ
positions.catalyst: After Tuesday's close IonQ announced the industry's first end-to-end real-time quantum error-correction decoder running on a single standard CPU, tested on circuits simulating up to 408 logical qubits and 31.5M operations with 0.02% overhead. +11.9% pre-market to $45.60 on 7.4M shares pre-open.
positions.risks: Gap-and-fade risk: a research milestone, not revenue. Stock is 46% below its October 2025 high of $84.64; PE -8.96. Russell 2000 futures -0.5% into the open.

positions.name: Maplebear (Instacart)
positions.catalyst: Instacart announced customers can use Meta's personal AI agent Muse on its grocery platform - the second Muse commerce integration after Shopify on Monday. +4.1% pre-market to $46.25 (prior close $44.41).
positions.risks: No economics disclosed. Costco just signed delivery deals with DoorDash and Uber, a direct competitive threat; CART fell 2.5% Tuesday. 52-week range $32.73-$52.68.

positions.name: Meta Platforms
positions.catalyst: KeyBanc raised its PT to $900 from $780 (Overweight). Muse is tracking near 70% of ChatGPT's adoption curve, and Shopify (Mon) and Instacart (Wed) signed in-agent commerce deals in back-to-back sessions. $739.18 pre-market vs $736.60 close.
positions.risks: Stock is 4% below its 52-week high of $770.60; KeyBanc hike is one broker. Muse monetization is unproven and implies heavier inference capex.
positions.driver: KeyBanc PT hike + Muse commerce partner momentum

positions.name: Valero Energy
positions.catalyst: Goldman Sachs (Neil Mehta) raised its PT to $457 from $365, Buy. $379.78 pre-market vs $377.14 close.
positions.risks: WTI down 1.65% to ~$89 and Brent back under $100 on Trump's Iran-deal comments; VLO is 9% off its Sept 21 52-week high of $419.04 and ran from $155 a year ago.

positions.name: Microsoft
positions.catalyst: Stifel (Brad Reback) upgraded to Buy from Hold and raised the PT to $575 from $530. +0.8% pre-market to $502.11 vs $498.00 close.
positions.risks: Single-broker upgrade on a $3.7T name; 10-year yield near 5% and 57.6% CME odds of an October Fed hike weigh on long-duration tech. 52-week range $349.20-$553.72.

positions.name: Royal Caribbean Group
positions.catalyst: Confirmed a $3B purchase of a 50% stake in Sandals and Beaches Resorts (values Sandals at $6B, ~10x forward EBITDA, expected accretive next year, closing early 2027). +1.8% pre-market to $239.15 after sliding to a 52-week low of $231.03 on Tuesday's report.
positions.risks: Debt-financed via Morgan Stanley, and the market sold the report first. Stock is 33% below its February high of $356.39 - a contrarian bounce off a fresh low, not trend-following.
positions.driver: Sandals $3B JV confirmation off a 52-week low

positions.name: Archer-Daniels-Midland
positions.catalyst: Xi is in the US Sept 23-25 and meets Trump Thursday; agricultural purchase commitments (soybeans; possible corn and sorghum) are the most likely deliverable, directly feeding ADM Ag Services volumes. EXIT TRIGGER: close on the Trump-Xi summit outcome (Thursday Sept 24 readout), win or lose.
positions.risks: Jefferies and others expect only incremental results; ADM is +48% YTD so much is pre-bought, and it fell 1.3% Tuesday to $82.30. 52-week range $55.58-$88.75.
